name: Dr Luchuo Engelbert Bain, MD, PhD, FAAS
bio:
Dr. Luchuo Engelbert Bain is the Co-Founder and the Executive Chairperson of The Career Café and a global health expert. He
is also the convener of Global Health Otherwise, a platform advancing equitable partnerships,
thought leadership, and African-led solutions. Dr. Bain champions the decolonization of global
health discourse, health diplomacy, and impactful science communication, while advising
international organizations and mentoring emerging leaders across the continent. At The Career
Café, he provides strategic direction, thought leadership, and vision for long-term impact.

name: Ms. Ivy Sirikwa Ogore
bio:
Ms. Ivy Sirikwa Ogore is the Co-Founder and Chief Operations Officer of The Career Café. She brings strong experience in leadership, operations, and strategy, with a background in managing teams and driving growth in the microfinance and entrepreneurship ecosystem. Ivy leads organizational
strategy, partnerships, and program execution, ensuring The Career Café runs efficiently and
delivers high-impact initiatives. She is passionate about building systems, empowering young
people, and creating practical pathways for career growth and entrepreneurship across Africa.

name: Ajime Tom
bio: Ajime Tom is a biomedical scientist and quality science professional with experience across research, quality control, and scientific operations within the medical, biomedical, pharmaceutical, and chemical sectors. Currently serving as a Quality Science Graduate Scientist at GSK in Belgium, he brings a strong background in scientific research, leadership, communication, and project coordination. As the Europe Regional Representative for The Career Café, Ajime supports the organization’s mission of fostering professional growth, global collaboration, and future-focused conversations around leadership, innovation, and workforce transformation across Africa and beyond.

name: Marcel Nkwain Yuh
bio:
Marcel Nkwain Yuh is a seasoned Chartered Accountant and business advisory professional with over 11 years of experience across East and Central Africa and the UAE. He currently serves as Regional Manager at EXCI-MAA and Managing Director of Career Café Ltd Rwanda, where he leads initiatives focused on professional development, business advisory, and workforce solutions. 

With expertise spanning statutory audits, tax compliance, and strategic advisory across multiple sectors, Marcel brings a strong understanding of both international standards and African market realities. As Rwanda Hub Lead for The Career Café, he supports the organization’s vision of advancing leadership, workforce transformation, and professional growth across the region.

name: Sarah Motlalepule  Banda
role: Communications and Social Media Operations Lead
bio:
Sarah Motlalepule Banda is the Communications and Social Media Operations Lead at The Career Café, with
over five years of experience in digital media and customer engagement. She leads content creation and day-to-day social media operations, ensuring The Career Café’s voice is clear,
engaging, and consistent across platforms. With a strong audience-centered approach, Sarah
translates programs, opportunities, and ideas into compelling stories that build community,
grow visibility, and strengthen the organization’s impact.

name: Abed Mensah Tekpe
role: Regional Focal Person for West & Central Africa
bio: Abed Mensah Tekpe is the Regional Focal Person for West & Central Africa at The Career Café. He plays a key role in coordinating regional partnerships, supporting program delivery, and strengthening The Career Café’s presence across the region. With a strong background in operations, administration and multi-stakeholder coordination, Abed supports executive leadership, oversees planning and execution of regional activities, and ensures effective communication across teams. He brings a structured, detail-oriented, and solutions-driven approach to his work and thrives in fast-paced, mission-driven environments. His work focuses on building strong systems, enabling smooth collaboration, and expanding The Career Café’s impact across West and Central Africa.
